name: Forged in Foxborough
overview: Get an exclusive look at the 2025 New England Patriots with never-before-seen access inside the walls of Gillette Stadium. Go behind the scenes with new head coach Mike Vrabel, starting quarterback Drake Maye, free agent signing Stefon Diggs, first round draft pick Will Campbell, and more. Forged in Foxborough is presented by Mass General Brigham.

trailers.title: TRAILER: Forged In Foxborough | Exclusive Look at the 2025 New England Patriots
